when_to_use: Evaluate visible behavior criteria independently across videos and return all supported option labels. Only for questions explicitly allowing multiple correct choices; not single-choice video pairs or open answers. The question explicitly permits multiple correct option labels and asks about visible behavior, interactions or conditions. Exclude single-choice questions, even when one option names several videos.
strategy:
1. Read each option as a claim; preserve simultaneous-action requirements, quantifiers and the requested number of answers without redefining behavior.
2. Use analyze_videos for all relevant videos. Give each VideoAgent its local criteria, asking for actions, objects, posture, temporal overlap and timestamped support or uncertainty.
3. Evaluate each option independently. If a brief event or alleged absence determines an unresolved option, request a focused re-observation through analyze_videos or inspect relevant clips with watch_videos.
4. Return all supported option letters in the requested format. Do not force one video or one letter; do not count a near match as a match.

Constraints:
Shared objects do not prove simultaneous actions. An unmentioned event is not evidence of absence. Do not invent definitions for subjective wording.
